templates.html:
<button type="button" class="btn-ghost{{#if underline}} btn-ghost--underline{{/if}}" style="--bg:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
<style>
.btn-ghost {
  font: 600 15px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--bg);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(36,20,48,.06); }
.btn-ghost--underline:hover:not(:disabled) { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
.btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
</style>
